in_hindi.name: अप्रा
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who is not established, unmanifest, not yet existed.

in_tamil.name: அப்ரா
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who is beyond the three worlds or the physical universe.

in_telugu.name: ఆప్రా
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who is not present or existing, unmanifest.

in_marathi.name: Apra
